title: Seismic reinforcing.
officialText:
Masonry or concrete fireplaces shall be constructed, anchored, supported and reinforced as required
in this chapter. In Seismic Design Category C or D, masonry and concrete fireplaces shall be reinforced and anchored as detailed
in Sections 2111.3.1, 2111.3.2, 2111.4 and 2111.4.1 for chimneys serving fireplaces. In Seismic Design Category B,
reinforcement and seismic anchorage is not required.
